title: Best Toasters UK
short: 2-slice and 4-slice toasters compared by settings, slot size and price, from budget to premium.
intro: A toaster is a simple appliance, but slot depth, even browning and how long it lasts vary a lot between models. This guide compares toasters picked by Mumsnet, from a budget 4-slice option under £30 to premium models built to last for decades.

products.name: NewGen Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who want a toaster built to last decades
products.summary: Mumsnet's overall pick, praised for its sleek design and Peek and Pop feature that lets you check toast without cancelling the cycle. Owners report it lasting for decades, though it is expensive.
cons: Peek and Pop struggles with thick crumpets

products.name: Long-Slot Four-Slice Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who want maximum capacity for a low price
products.summary: A very affordable long-slot toaster that fits large slices and pitta bread, with seven settings, though the design is basic.
pros: Accommodates large slices and pitta bread

products.name: Inspire Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who want a stylish, reliable everyday toaster
products.summary: A stylish, easy-to-use toaster with even toasting and good value across its price range, though it struggles with larger bread slices.

products.name: VTT981 Edge Two-Slice Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who regularly toast thick or homemade bread
products.summary: A toaster with deep slots designed for tall slices, with a lift-and-look feature and brushed stainless steel finish, though the casing gets very hot.
pros: Deep slots for thick or tall slices

products.name: Smart Two-Slice Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who want precise, tech-forward toasting
products.summary: A high-tech toaster with a Quick Look setting and wide slots for even browning, at a premium price.

products.name: Icona Metallics Four-Slice Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers who want a retro look with bagel and defrost settings
products.summary: A stylish retro-look toaster with a browning control dial and bagel, defrost and reheat settings, though it is bulky and the outer slots can toast unevenly.

products.name: Breakfast Suite 2-Slice Toaster
products.best_for: Buyers with an eye on style who toast a variety of breads
products.summary: A stylish toaster with wide slots and seven settings that toasts quickly, well suited to varied and homemade bread, at a high price.

guide.a: A 2-slice toaster suits one or two people and takes up less counter space. A 4-slice toaster, or a long-slot model, suits families or anyone who often toasts more than two slices, bagels, or pitta bread at once.

A wide browning range helps you get everything from lightly toasted to well-done. Dedicated bagel, defrost and reheat settings are useful if you eat those regularly, but add cost if you never use them.

Premium toasters like the Dualit are built to last for many years and often toast more evenly, which can make the cost per year lower than replacing a cheap toaster every couple of years. A budget toaster is still fine for occasional or light use.

guide.q: How do I keep a toaster in good condition?
guide.a: Empty and clean the crumb tray regularly to reduce fire risk and keep toasting even, and unplug it before cleaning.
